tests.note: slot 2 busy<0 off: SPECIAL BUSY, MP and busy unchanged; on: cast true, MP < pool, busy > 0

rules.semantic: EXPLODING BOLT refused 'SPECIAL BUSY' while busy; classic ~= 0, fixed > 0 (fix S). Same rule as :29.

tests.note: slot 3 busy<0 off: SPECIAL BUSY; on: fires
slot 3: busy 0 casts, busy 0.25 SPECIAL BUSY, both values

rules.semantic: The exploding bolt is one fire arrow with skip_exit=5000 (the 'explodes on contact' mark), hp 500 and damage x2; if the fire arrow cannot be fired the cast fails 'COULD NOT FIRE' and the archer keeps its ordinary weapon either way.

arms.observable: one FIRE_ARROW in weaplist, skip_exit 5000, hp 500, damage 2x base; current_weapon restored

rules.semantic: An archer struck by a new attacker (or with no foe) switches its foe to the attacker, clears its command queue and resets its pursuit distances to 15000; a repeat hit from its current foe keeps its orders.

arms.observable: foe == attacker (asserted); current/last distance 15000 (asserted); commands cleared (executed-only: both cited tests clear_command() BEFORE hit_response)

rules.semantic: An archer hit from inside 64 px backpedals: a forced 8-step WALK directly away from the attacker (sign of archer-attacker per axis, int16-narrowed).

arms.observable: forced COMMAND_WALK 8 (sign dx, sign dy) away

tests.note: within 64: one forced WALK 8 (-1,0); at 200 px: no command
